what.text: This page follows refugees from Rwanda living in Burundi, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 840 Rwandan refugees in Burundi, 0.3% of all refugees from Rwanda.
The Democratic Republic of the Congo hosts the most Rwandan refugees, followed by Uganda, France and Malawi.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Rwanda in periods from 1990 to 2025, most recently with FDLR-FOCA.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1980 to 1995, include the 1990 to 1994 period of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1961 at 30000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 278092, at the end of 1994, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Burundi.
These are year-end totals for Burundi only, reported to UNHCR.
